answer: Your records do not list any allergies or intolerances. That does not prove you have none. It means no allergy entry is in the records I could see, so I cannot tell you whether you are allergic to anything. Your medicine list shows metformin, empagliflozin (Jardiance) and atorvastatin, but none of those is recorded with a reaction. Please tell your doctor and pharmacist about any reaction you have had to a medicine, food or other substance, and ask the clinic to add any allergies to your record so they show up for future prescriptions.
short: No allergies are recorded in the records I could see. That does not prove there are none; please confirm with your doctor and ask them to add any you have.

knowledge.says: Allergy lists in medical records are often incomplete, so a missing entry does not mean there is no allergy. Reactions to medicines are best confirmed with the patient and the prescriber.
